The eight gates remain quality acceptance checks and are excluded from timing. Baseline and candidate each run once on the same host/runtime/environment, with the same command and timer boundaries, while each runs all E2E suites belonging to its own revision.
Dependency preparation is completed before timing. Timing starts immediately before the E2E process and ends when it exits; setup, cleanup, and other gates are excluded.

The record table captures revision SHA, host/Node/pnpm, exact command and E2E scope, elapsed seconds, explicit process result/status, executed test count, and raw output location. Incomplete runs are not represented as completed elapsed-time samples.
The known baseline 141 versus candidate 139 case counts are handled as a quality/parity check, not used to claim or score performance improvement. Times are reference values only.

Phase 0 keeps baseline measurement pending until a clean baseline checkout and complete test files are verified. The currently known baseline clone is unusable because 100 tracked test files, including 21 E2E files, are deleted. The invalid wrong-inventory attempt stopped before gates and is not a measurement; the 359.64-second candidate all-gates dry-run is historical and not an E2E measurement.

Completion criteria require one valid E2E measurement per revision with conditions and results recorded; Phase 0 is not marked complete while baseline remains on HOLD. Historical 8-gate timing machinery and resource/manifests are clearly identified as superseded history rather than active measurement requirements.

state.outputRequirement: Return exactly one selected choice and a complete probability distribution and confidence. valid_as_defined means the actual current protocol, status, and completion criteria are coherent and meet the supplied criteria. For any non-pass reason category, provide a case-specific finding, affected plan section or requirement, observed evidence from the supplied text, and a concrete proposed fix or exact additional evidence needed. If evidence does not permit judgment, choose indeterminate and state the specific missing evidence. Do not infer severity from the reason category or invent evidence.

plan.instructions: Does the current plan's measurement protocol, Phase 0/HOLD state, and completion criteria form a sufficient, internally consistent protocol for recording one valid pre-migration baseline and one post-migration candidate E2E reference measurement? Return the full probability distribution over the mutually exclusive choices.

criteria.valid_as_defined: The current plan is coherent and sufficient as written, including its explicit pending/HOLD status.
criteria.requirements_mismatch: A stated requirement conflicts with the requested measurement goal; identify the conflict and correction.
criteria.missing_prerequisites_info: A prerequisite is missing; identify the exact information needed.
criteria.incomplete_implementation_info: The plan or evidence is incomplete for judgment; identify the exact missing detail/evidence.
criteria.implementation_issue: The operational protocol has an issue; identify the step, supplied evidence, and correction.
criteria.scope_violation: The protocol exceeds or falls outside the stated scope; identify the boundary and adjustment.
criteria.other: A material concern does not fit the categories; provide its location, evidence, and fix or needed evidence.
criteria.indeterminate: The supplied context cannot support a judgment; identify the missing context if possible.
